GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and Biodiversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Skeletal and Muscular System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Carbon and its Oxides and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
